methods.doc: Upsert the generated NPCs from worlds/<world>/actors.json. Run { dryRun: true } first. A thrown PentarynAbort means nothing was written (version gate, @ref lint, malformed entry, fetch, non-GM, a bad option, an import already running on this tab); a thrown PentarynAssertionError means a readback failed and the batch is partial (actors before it were written). A PentarynAbort carries a kit code: NOT_FOUND (no file at path), NOT_GM, BAD_ARGS, CONFLICT (already running), TIMEOUT, else REFUSED. Per-actor write failures do not throw: they come back as { ok: false, failed: [{ slug, error }] }.
Live smoke checks after a sync: published, the module.json gate flags present, the legacy root.
